metrics.fanout_opportunity: Planning opportunity only; not a page or citation.
metrics.approved_content: Editorial item approved by the existing Dianne content system.
metrics.published_page: Public page released by the existing validated auto-publish system.
metrics.search_visibility: Observed search impression or result evidence.
metrics.llm_surfacing: Observed LLM mention or answer-surface evidence.
metrics.external_reference: Observed backlink or external reference evidence.
metrics.verified_citation: Externally observed citation or linked reference with evidence.

truth_rules: 100K is a stretch target, not a guarantee.
Fanout, approvals, pages, indexing, impressions, LLM mentions, backlinks, and verified citations remain distinct.
Editorial publication authority remains the existing Dianne validated publishing system.
